## Key Facts

- Cheapest plan: Freedom Plan 250 at AED 188/month (25% off from AED 250) — non-stop data at 3Mbps, 1,000 local minutes, free Silver number
- Best value: Unlimited Calls Plan 600 Flexi at AED 360/month (40% off from AED 600) — 50GB data, unlimited local + international flexi minutes
- Premium tier: Platinum Plan at AED 1,000/month — unlimited data at max speed, unlimited flexi minutes, 20GB roaming, Platinum VIP number
- Best for international calling: Unlimited 1 Country Plan 325 at AED 325/month (Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Philippines, etc.)
- Premium Numbers: Silver (free with most plans from AED 188), Gold (with AED 500/mo Gold plans), Platinum (with AED 1,000/mo Platinum plan)
- eSIM: Available for all postpaid plans. Compatible with iPhone 14+, Samsung Galaxy S23+, Google Pixel 7+
- 5G: Included on all Freedom plans at no extra cost. Coverage active in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and other UAE cities.
- Number porting (MNP): Switch from du to Etisalat in 2-3 business days. Keep your existing mobile number.
- Coverage: All UAE — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain
- Payment: Card swipe only on delivery (debit/credit card) — no cash, no bank transfer
- Free same-day SIM delivery (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah); 1-2 days other emirates
- Languages: English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu support
- Hours: 9 AM – 9 PM UAE time, every day
- Contact: WhatsApp +971 56 902 8087

## Plan Categories

1. **Freedom Non-Stop Data (4 plans)**: AED 188-500/month. Continuous data at guaranteed speeds (3-50 Mbps), local minutes, free Silver number with select tiers.
2. **Freedom Unlimited Data (11 plans)**: AED 150-1,000/month. High-speed data with GB allocations, calling allowances, free Silver/Gold number with select tiers.
3. **Freedom Unlimited Calling (7 plans)**: AED 195-600/month. Unlimited local and/or international calling, generous data, roaming on premium tiers.
4. **Premium Numbers Tier**: Silver (free with plan), Gold (AED 500/mo plans), Platinum (AED 1,000/mo plan). Stand-alone numbers also available.
